The Lallantop Show, Episode no. 2134| 13 November 2026
In today’s LT show, Abhishek is discussing the following news:
In Today’s The Lallantop Show, the discussion will be on inflation. In October, the retail inflation rate rose to 6.09%, up from 5.54% in September 2026. This is the highest level in the past two years. Food inflation has increased from 7.74% to reach 8.94% in October. Many experts believe that inflation figures will not decrease in the coming days. We will understand the reasons behind this from experts and also learn how rising inflation impacts the overall economy.
